adjudication_record.respondent: CyberTech Enterprise Solutions Inc., Arthur Sterling (CEO), Claire Vance (CFO)
adjudication_record.enforcement_division: SEC Division of Enforcement & Office of the Chief Accountant
statutes_violated: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 Section 10(b) and Rule 10b-5 (Fraudulent Disclosures)
Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 Section 302 (False Executive Certifications)
adjudication_record.findings_summary: The Commission found that during the Q3 2023 earnings conference call and related Form 10-Q filing, Sterling and Vance knowingly engaged in deceptive communicative acts: (1) concealing $285 million in accelerated debt maturities and impending covenant default; (2) orally denying the existence of extended payment terms while secretly recognizing $88.5M in unbilled contracts with 360-day terms; and (3) misrepresenting an irrevocable $185M parent guarantee on an unconsolidated foreign affiliate as non-recourse.
